# Scintilla 5.6.9

Official source: https://www.scintilla.org/scintilla569.zip

Archive SHA-256: `fddc637afa6e3a9205a5ad67c777d711a921ed2797d792f3034010c1be1539d6`

License: [License.txt](License.txt). Upstream files are unmodified. `build.rs`
compiles the core and Win32 platform sources into a static library; it does not
include SciTE, Lexilla, or language lexers. This publication includes the core,
headers and Win32 build sources. Upstream tests, documentation and other platform
ports are omitted; included upstream source files are unchanged.

Documentation: https://www.scintilla.org/ScintillaDoc.html
